audience: subscription teams with authorized Recurpay custom-app access

useCases.title: Find failed renewals
useCases.text: List halted subscriptions and inspect their subscriber and next billing details.

useCases.title: Review a subscriber’s orders
useCases.text: Find a subscriber and read the orders generated by subscriptions.

useCases.title: Skip an agreed billing cycle
useCases.text: Skip the next billing and delivery cycle for the selected subscription.

useCases.title: Retry an approved renewal
useCases.text: Renew immediately only after explicit approval; the saved payment method may be charged.

useCases.title: Send an agreed payment link
useCases.text: Generate a link only after explicit approval; Recurpay notifies the subscriber.
